stem_book: A stiff horizontal spring of weight W and force constant k is suspended in a horizontal position by two light strings attached to its two ends. Each string makes an angle θ with the vertical. The extension of the spring is: (a) (W/4k) tanθ (b) (W/2k) tanθ (c) (W/4k) sinθ (d) zero
work: 2T cosθ = W → spring tension = T sinθ = (W/2) tanθ → x = (W/2k) tanθ
